title: Hereticon founder's startup to reverse engineer UFOs with quantum computing

tellings.quote: There's a founder here at Hereticon, who maybe is one of the most heretical thinkers here. He's trying to reverse engineer UFOs with, uh, quantum computing.

plain: In 2022, at Hereticon, a Miami gathering for people with deliberately unpopular ideas, one startup founder was said to be trying to "reverse engineer" UFOs (work out how they are built and how they work) using quantum computing. Michels tells it himself from the event, calling the founder "maybe one of the most heretical thinkers here", but he does not name him or say what the work involves.
